correctAnswer: Chlorine present as hypochlorous acid and hypochlorite ion that has not combined with other substances
explanation: Free chlorine is the portion available as hypochlorous acid and hypochlorite ion. Combined chlorine, such as chloramines, is measured separately as part of total chlorine.
options: Chlorine that has already been consumed by the demand in the water
Chlorine present as hypochlorous acid and hypochlorite ion that has not combined with other substances
Chlorine combined only with ammonia to form chloramines
Chlorine stored in the feed tank before dosing

The sample bottle becomes too cold to open
The residual can change quickly because chlorine reacts with substances in the water and is affected by light and temperature
The reagent stops working once a sample is one hour old
